title: On critical dimensions for compactness in the boundary Yamabe problem, I
summary: We construct smooth, non-locally-conformally-flat metrics on the closed ball for which the boundary Yamabe equation admits $L^\infty$-unbounded sequences of positive solutions. The background metric and the prescribed scalar and boundary mean curvatures are fixed along each sequence. For zero scalar curvature and positive boundary mean curvature, such examples exist with umbilic boundary in every dimension $N\ge22$ and with nonumbilic boundary in every $N\ge15$.
